coordinateSystem.sideConvention: image-left and image-right are primary; anatomical sides must never silently replace image coordinates
coordinateSystem.cableDirection: the rear cable bundle extends toward image-right and folds back

designAnchors.requirement: Clearly adult, extremely slender and vertically elongated humanoid proportions; never childlike, chibi, petite-idol or round-faced.
Long narrow mature face, small controlled mouth, restrained expression and sharp jaw relationship; no generic soft anime beauty face.
In the unmirrored canonical view, image-left is the white-light eye structure and image-right is the black-dark eye structure. Preserve this exact assignment; this is not ordinary two-color irises.
Pale silver-grey hair is structured into hard graphic segments; the rear high bundle is a thick cable/conduit assembly extending toward image-right and folding back, not a fluffy natural ponytail.
White hard shell plates, black inner construction, collar interfaces and exposed mechanical divisions define the neck, shoulders and thorax.
The abdomen is an authored open frame/cavity with visible structural members; it must not become cloth, corset fashion, bare skin or a closed bodysuit.
Both mechanical arms form the canonical restrained crossing silhouette in front of the waist; preserve elbow, forearm and hand placement.
Long narrow black lower-body structure with canonical white panel partitions; never a dress, skirt, coat hem or generic trousers.
Preserve the canonical black, white and cool-grey value blocks and their side-specific placement before applying Krea2 rendering treatment.

productionRule.style: Apply the locked six-LoRA Krea2 production rendering language to the canonical design without replacing its silhouette, anatomy, component topology or side assignments.
productionRule.output: A complete standalone character render on one normalized transparent target canvas. The generated render is the output; it must never be pasted into the canonical source canvas as a differently sized inset.

renderMode.occupancyRule: The final non-transparent subject bounds must remain full-height and must not become an inset, thumbnail, centered small figure or letterboxed render.

forbidden: ImageCompositeMasked between mismatched canvas coordinate spaces

requiredReview: GCLI Gemini paired review against the canonical source
no inset, collage, seam, logo, watermark or text
geometryChecks: source and output dimensions and alpha state are hash-bound
subject bounding box is measured before promotion
head, cable far edge, hands and feet are not cropped
no added skirt, coat hem, cape, wing, tail or extra limb
all resize, crop, mask and composite operations are recorded in the receipt
